column1: # The colour literals the shared controls have today (docs/specs/ui-refresh-plan.md section 9; package UI-1): Color.FromArgb, FromRgb and
# FromScRgb calls and hex colours in OpenPmsDental/UI, the shared looks of CodeBase/UI (UI-PLAIN), OpenPmsDentalBusiness/UI/GridOD.cs and
# UiThemeScanTests fails on a literal that is not here (use a UiTheme token) and on a row the source no longer has as often (cut the list):
# each control package shrinks it. OPMS_UI_COLOUR_LITERALS_WRITE=1 writes it again from the source.
# file: relative to the repository root, forward slashes. literal: the call without whitespace, or the hex colour in capitals. count: how often.
# UI-11: the chrome colour literals (docs/port-notes/UI-11.md): every literal BackColor and ForeColor value (a named colour, a system colour, Color.FromArgb
# with numbers) that the designers and the code of the program's projects set and that stays, with the reason. A chrome literal (a window,
# panel, group box, tab page, label or check box in an old background: Windows' grey, white, 252,253,254) is not here: its line went, so the
# control takes the token from its parent and the looks. NoHqTests' ChromeColourScanTests fails on a literal this table does not list and on
# a row the source no longer has as often. python tools/UiFit/colour_literals.py writes it (--check compares), with the reasons of its rules.
# file: relative, forward slashes. control: the designer's field ("." the window), or the code's expression. count: how often.
